data_stage: bash media/make_media.sh data (judge/grade.sh on examples/good, the 10 judge/mutants.py mutants and the replay artifacts, all with --json; plus judge/selftest.sh)

result.png.shows: the delivered part (examples/good STL parsed with trimesh 5.1.1) beside the spec-built reference solid with the manifold3d XOR difference, the DXF bolt-circle overlay with angular deviations vs the G6 tolerance, and per-gate measured errors vs pass limits

loop.png.shows: the fixing-agent loop replay (gates passing per iteration with the 14/14 pass line) and the mutant x gate matrix (known-good + 10 mutants x 14 gates) with red cells showing measured vs limit

demo.mp4.shows: storyboarded to media/STORYBOARD.md: a full-frame turntable of the real delivered STL rendered offscreen by VTK, a push-in on the bolt circle, then full-frame cards of result.png and loop.png (per-gate verdict vs the spec; the agent loop and the mutant x gate kill matrix), and the static end card (34.7 s, 1920x1080, 30 fps, H.264)
